# Load libraries

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(biomaRt)
library(CellChat)
```



# Read in data

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_tumour_RNAseq <- read.table("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_tumours/tumours_bulk_RNAseq/GSE101336_KPC_processed_matrix_FPKM.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```



# Format data.frame structure

```{r}
colnames(KPC_tumour_RNAseq) <- c("gene_id", "tss_id", "locus", "KPC_7", "KPC_8", "KPC_9", "KPC_10")

# Convert gene_id to ENSEMBL and make rownames
ensembl_ids <- mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = KPC_tumour_RNAseq$gene_id,
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  column = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"  # if multiple ENSEMBL IDs, take the first
)

KPC_FPKM <- data.frame(
  ensembl_id = ensembl_ids[KPC_tumour_RNAseq$gene_id],
  KPC_tumour_RNAseq,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

KPC_FPKM <- KPC_FPKM[!is.na(KPC_FPKM$ensembl_id), ]

KPC_FPKM <- KPC_FPKM[!duplicated(KPC_FPKM$ensembl_id), ]

rownames(KPC_FPKM) <- KPC_FPKM$ensembl_id

KPC_FPKM$ensembl_id <- NULL
```



# KPC FPKM values to TPM

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Prepare counts matrix
KPC_FPKM_values <- KPC_FPKM[, c("KPC_7", "KPC_8", "KPC_9", "KPC_10")]

# Make sure values are numeric
KPC_FPKM_values <- as.matrix(KPC_FPKM_values)
storage.mode(KPC_FPKM_values) <- "numeric"

# Convert to TPM
KPC_TPM <- apply(KPC_FPKM_values, 2, function(x) {
  (x / sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)) * 1e6
})
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(KPC_FPKM_values, KPC_tumour_RNAseq, ensembl_ids)
```



# Get list of genes for "Secreted" proteins from Human Protein Atlas, then map to mouse orthologs

## Filter secreted protein list from HPA
### NOTE - I downloaded a list of HPA.

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa <- read.delim("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/proteinatlas.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

hpa_secreted <- hpa[grepl("Secreted proteins|Predicted secreted proteins", hpa$Protein.class), ]

# Human secreted gene list
hpa_secreted_genes <- hpa_secreted$Ensembl
```


## Map human genes to mouse orthologs
### NOTE - I downloaded a file from BioMart that converted human genes to mouse orthologs

```{r, include=FALSE}
orthologs <- read.table("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/human_to_mouse_orthologs.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "", fill = TRUE)

# Subset for orthology_confidence = 1 (high confidence of gene mapping)
orthologs <- orthologs[orthologs$orthology_confidence == 1, ]

# Filter orthologs for human secreted proteins
orthologs_secreted <- orthologs[orthologs$human_gene_id %in% hpa_secreted_genes, ]

# Filter orthologs for mouse genes
KPC_secreted_ids <- unique(orthologs_secreted$mouse_gene_id)
```


## Filter TPM for secreted genes, then for TPM > 0

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_TPM_secreted <- KPC_TPM[rownames(KPC_TPM) %in% KPC_secreted_ids, ]

KPC_TPM_secreted <- KPC_TPM_secreted[rowSums(KPC_TPM_secreted > 0) == ncol(KPC_TPM_secreted), ]
```


## Add in gene names and make rownames

```{r, include=FALSE}
gene_symbols <- mapIds(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = rownames(KPC_TPM_secreted),
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL",
    multiVals = "first"
)

KPC_TPM_secreted <- as.data.frame(KPC_TPM_secreted)

KPC_TPM_secreted$gene_symbol <- gene_symbols[rownames(KPC_TPM_secreted)]
```


## Get a list of genes secreted by KPC tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_secreted_genes <- KPC_TPM_secreted$gene_symbol
```

```{r, inlcude=FALSE}
write.table(KPC_secreted_genes, 
            file = "KPC_secreted_genes.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```



# Get list of matching receptors for secreted genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the built-in mouse ligand-receptor database
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse

# Subset the interactions table for ligands in your secreted gene list
lr_KPC <- subset(CellChatDB$interaction, ligand %in% KPC_secreted_genes)

# Extract receptors that line up with secreted genes
KPC_receptors <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(lr_KPC$receptor.symbol, ","))))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.table(KPC_receptors, 
            file = "KPC_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```
